entities.name: Raiyuu
entities.description: A human samurai and captain in the Asari Uprisers on Kamigawa, imbued with the power of lightning and thunder.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: Imperial tax collectors and forces who arrested Raiyuu's friends.

entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: Region whose village Raiyuu went to free.

events.summary: Raiyuu's friends were caught in an avalanche and arrested by the Imperials during a thunderstorm.
events.quote: Raiyuu's friends were caught in an avalanche and quickly arrested by the Imperials.

events.summary: Lightning struck Raiyuu's sword, imbuing him with the power of lightning and thunder.
events.quote: the storm imbued him with the power of lightning and thunder

events.summary: Raiyuu single-handedly freed his friends and became a hero to the Asari uprisers.
events.quote: He single-handedly freed his friends and became a hero

relations.quote: captain in the Asari Uprisers in Kamigawa
to free a Sokenzan village from a group of unfair Imperial tax collectors
